nodes.label: ADAM17
props: Snake venom-like protease; TNF-alpha convertase; TNF-alpha-converting enzyme

Transmembrane metalloprotease which mediates the ectodomain shedding of a myriad of transmembrane proteins including adhesion proteins, growth factor precursors and cytokines important for inflammation and immunity. Cleaves the membrane-bound precursor of TNF to its mature soluble form.

nodes.label: EGFR
props: Proto-oncogene c-ErbB-1; Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-1

Receptor tyrosine kinase binding ligands of the EGF family and activating several signaling cascades to convert extracellular cues into appropriate cellular responses. Known ligands include EGF, TGFA/TGF-alpha, AREG, epigen/EPGN, BTC/betacellulin, epiregulin/EREG and HBEGF/heparin-binding EGF.
